passages.context: The inspected Syriac preserves bringing Abram outside, looking toward heaven and counting the stars at 15:5; the sun toward setting at 15:12 and again at 15:17; and 'on that day' at 15:18. It inserts no explicit interval, but the unidentified digital textual base prevents an edition-critical claim about the Peshitta tradition.
